title: The Rewind: Ditto

reader_summary.headline: Today, we're featuring another episode of The Rewind.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we're featuring another episode of The Rewind, in which Howard looks back on some of his memos over the years, discusses their origins. In this episode, Howard will be discussing the memo, Ditto, with Bruce Flat, the CEO of Brookfield. Howard and Bruce were interviewed by Anna Schumanski, Oak Tree's senior financial writer.

thesis: Howard Marks argues that markets are never perfect and that the riskiest investment error is the belief that risk has been eliminated, which leads investors to engage in dangerous behavior. He emphasizes that while value is determined by long-term discounted cash flows, price is often distorted by market cycles, causing investors to buy euphorically at high prices and sell in panic at low prices.
